t.en: Compute linear combinations of vectors algebraically and geometrically.
Determine whether a vector is a linear combination of given vectors.
Find the coefficients of one vector as a linear combination of other vectors.

Now that we have studied both vector addition and scalar multiplication, we can combine the two operations. You may remember that when we talked about the solutions to homogeneous systems of equations in Section 〔引用〕, we briefly mentioned that the general solution of a homogeneous system is a linear combination of its basic solutions. We now return to the concept of a linear combination.
